sources.snippet: Qwen3.8-27B System Requirements VRAM 9-56GB, Apache-2.0 Licensed [2026] Qwen3.8-27B weights landed on August 15, 2026. sources.title: Run Qwen3 Locally: GPU Requirements, Setup & Costs (2026) | Spheron
sources.snippet: TL;DR: GPU Requirements to Run Qwen3 Locally Qwen3 4B and 8B run on a single 24GB consumer card at FP16, so an RTX 4090 handles them comfortably. Qwen3 14B and 32B need INT4 quantisation to fit 24-32GB, or a 48GB card at FP16. Qwen3 72B and the MoE variants exceed any single consumer GPU: budget 2x 80GB at FP16, or one 141GB H200 at INT4.

sources.title: FP8-RL: A Practical and Stable Low-Precision Stack for LLM Reinforcement Learning
sources.snippet: Reinforcement learning (RL) for large language models (LLMs) is increasingly bottlenecked by rollout (generation), where long output sequence lengths make attention and KV-cache memory dominate end-to-end step time.
